answer_3.quote: LLM Judges: Exploring whether LLM can distinguish between humans and itself can also provide insights into its understanding of social interactions among humans. We select GPT-4 and Qwen-110B to serve as LLM judges.

answer_4.quote: Human Judges: In total, 236 native speakers participated in our survey as volunteer human judges.
answer_4.guideline: Each questionnaire consists of 11 questions: five pertain to the Turing test, asking to distinguish human from AI, and one asks respondents to explain their strategies.
